name: CryptoEx Multi-Chain Swap & Crypto Screener Widgets
author: tommyvideo

sections.description:
CryptoEx Multi-Chain Swap & Crypto Screener Widgets allows any WordPress site owner to instantly launch a complete Decentralized Exchange (DEX) token market screener, TradingView live charts, and a Cross-Chain Web3 Swap Terminal.

Whether you run a crypto news portal, Bitcoin & DeFi blog, financial website, or need a Buy Button / Swap Widget for your own meme coin project token, this plugin provides instant crypto utility without requiring API keys, CoinGecko subscriptions, CoinMarketCap Pro accounts, or programming knowledge.

Upon activation, the plugin automatically creates:
* /crypto-screener/: Full multi-chain crypto market screener with live charts, liquidity tracking, market trends, pump screener, and watchlist.
* /crypto-swap/: Fast multi-chain Web3 Swap Terminal supporting EVM (BSC, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, Sonic) and Solana networks with MetaMask, Phantom, Solflare, WalletConnect, and Trust Wallet.

Part of the CryptoEx WordPress Suite:

Explore our complete ecosystem of Web3 & trading plugins for WordPress:
* CryptoEx Multi-Chain Swap & Crypto Screener Widgets (This plugin) – Live multi-network screener and instant token swap terminal.
* CryptoEx DEX Pro Trading & Live Order Book – Institutional trading terminal with interactive TradingView candlestick charts, dynamic live bid/ask order book, and real-time trade streams.
* CryptoEx DeFi Yield Explorer & 1-Click Zap – High-yield liquidity pool aggregator with automated 1-click single-token zap routing into top LP positions.

Download the complete companion plugin collection at: CryptoEx Official WordPress Plugins

Key Features for Webmasters & Publishers:

  • Zero Configuration Needed: Automatically publishes ready-to-use pages on activation.
  • Smart Token Auto-Detection: Paste any contract address (EVM or Solana), and the plugin automatically identifies the network, token symbol, and pre-configures the widget.
  • Interactive Live Preview Sandbox: Test and preview your customized DEX Screener, Instant Token Swap Box, or dedicated Token Analytics page before publishing.
  • 1-Click Shortcode Generator: Easily generate and copy customized WordPress shortcodes with tailored dimensions, layouts (Compact or Full), and default trading actions (Buy/Sell).
  • Multi-Chain TradingView Charts: Real-time crypto price ticker and live candlestick charting across thousands of pairs on Solana, BSC, Base, Ethereum, and Sonic.
  • Cross-Chain Token Swaps: Best price execution powered by decentralized routing (Uniswap, PancakeSwap, Raydium, Jupiter DEX).
  • Universal Web3 Wallet Support: Full permission tags for MetaMask, Phantom (Solana), Solflare, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet, and WalletConnect.
  • Customizable Sizes & Themes: Easily adjust width, height, and layout (Full or Compact sidebar widget mode).
  • Promote Your Token: Pre-configure your custom token contract, meme coin, or Solana mint address so visitors can buy your project coin instantly on your own website.
  • Fully Responsive: Adapts seamlessly to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Supported Networks & Blockchains:

The CryptoEx DEX Screener and Web3 Swap Terminal provide real-time token radars, interactive candlestick charts, and instant non-custodial swaps across 70+ blockchains:

  • Direct Screener Filters (Featured on cryptoex.online/dex):

    • Major Networks: Solana, BNB Chain (BSC), Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One, Polygon, Sonic, Avalanche, Optimism, Sui, TRON.
    • High-Performance & Layer 2 Rollups: Blast, Linea, Scroll, zkSync Era, Mantle, Metis, Celo, Cronos, Sei.
    • Next-Gen & Emerging Ecosystems: Berachain, Unichain, Soneium, Ink, ApeChain, Abstract, World Chain.

  • Cross-Chain Web3 Swap Terminal:

    • Automated liquidity routing, optimal path finding, and instant token swaps across 70+ blockchains (supporting EVM chains, Solana SPL tokens, and top liquidity aggregators like 1inch, ParaSwap, Uniswap, PancakeSwap, and Jupiter).

External Services

This plugin relies on the CryptoEx platform services to render live crypto interactive market screeners, real-time charts, decentralized token swap routing, and Web3 wallet connectors directly on your WordPress site via embedded iframes.

  • What service is used:
    The plugin embeds the CryptoEx Web3 Terminal and Crypto Screener tools (https://cryptoex.online/dex and https://cryptoex.online/swap-terminal/).
  • What data is sent and when:
    When an embedded widget is loaded, the visitor’s browser establishes an HTTPS connection to cryptoex.online to fetch the interactive UI and market data. As with any web request or iframe, the visitor’s IP address and technical HTTP headers are received by the server to deliver the content. To protect user privacy, all iframes enforce referrerpolicy="no-referrer", preventing the host WordPress site’s origin URL or referring page from being sent. No personal user data, WordPress database content, or administrative site data is collected or stored. When a user connects a Web3 wallet (such as MetaMask or Phantom), transactions are signed directly on the user’s client browser and executed on the decentralized blockchain network.
  • Terms of Service & Privacy Policy:
    • CryptoEx Terms of Service: https://cryptoex.online/terms-and-condition
    • CryptoEx Privacy Policy: https://cryptoex.online/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cryptoex-swap-screener-widgets folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. The plugin will automatically generate /crypto-screener/ and /crypto-swap/ pages.
  4. Visit CryptoEx Widgets in your WordPress admin menu to generate shortcodes, preview widgets live, and customize options.
sections.faq:
Does it support Solana wallets like Phantom?

Yes! Both EVM wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Rabby, Coinbase) and Solana wallets (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) are fully supported.

Can I use this as a Buy Button or Swap Widget for my meme coin or token?

Yes! Simply navigate to CryptoEx Widgets settings in your WordPress dashboard and enter your token’s contract or mint address. The swap terminal will automatically pre-load your token.

Can I embed widgets in a sidebar, footer, or blog post?

Yes, use the [cryptoex_swap_terminal layout="compact"] shortcode inside any widget area, sidebar column, Elementor widget, or Gutenberg block.

Are any paid API keys or registration required?

No. Unlike other crypto plugins requiring paid CoinMarketCap or CoinGecko API plans, all CryptoEx widgets connect directly to decentralized liquidity protocols and public endpoints without any subscription or API keys required.

Can I replace Uniswap or PancakeSwap embeds with this?

Yes! This widget supports cross-chain swaps so your users can trade across multiple blockchains in one unified interface.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Major Admin UI overhaul: Modern dark Web3 glassmorphic design system with pure vector SVG icons.
  • Added Interactive Shortcode Generator with instant 1-click Copy-to-Clipboard functionality.
  • Added Live Preview Sandbox allowing real-time preview of widgets directly in the WordPress dashboard.
  • Added Smart Auto-Detection for custom tokens: Automatically detects blockchain networks (via DexScreener & GeckoTerminal APIs) upon entering a token contract address.
  • Expanded multi-chain coverage: Support for 70+ blockchain networks including Sonic, Solana, BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Polygon, Sui, Tron, and top Layer-2 rollups.
  • Fixed multi-chain DEX screener live embed route to ensure seamless preview without 404 errors.
  • Added streamlined 1-row promo integration for DEX Screener and DeFi Yield & Zap tools without bundling external images (keeping plugin size under 17 KB).
  • Suppressed third-party disruptive admin notices to ensure a clean, distraction-free administration interface.

1.1.2

  • Added anonymous installation ping and analytics telemetry on plugin activation.
  • Added widget platform source tagging to differentiate WordPress plugin embeds.
  • Performance optimizations and enhanced shortcode iframe parameters.

1.1.1

  • Updated Plugin URI and admin links to official WordPress Plugins Suite portal: https://cryptoex.online/wordpress-plugins
  • Added dedicated suite banner and companion plugin links in WordPress admin settings dashboard.
  • Added documentation for CryptoEx DEX Pro Trading and DeFi Yield Zap companion plugins.

1.1.0

  • Updated plugin display name and slug to comply with WordPress.org trademark policies.
  • Added official External Services disclosure section with Privacy Policy and Terms of Service links.
  • Added WordPress Admin Settings dashboard for custom widths, heights, themes, and default tokens.
  • Added support for compact sidebar widgets.
  • Fixed WordPress Coding Standards compatibility (unslashing, sanitization, and tag limits).

1.0.0

  • Initial release with automated page generation and shortcodes.
